guide.setup: Hold one dumbbell or kettlebell close to the chest, feet about shoulder width, and brace the trunk.
guide.execution: Sit down between the hips while keeping the load close, then stand by pushing through the whole foot.
guide.cues: Keep elbows under the weight. Spread the floor with the feet. Stay tall.
guide.mistakes: Letting the weight drift away; knees collapsing inward; heels lifting; rounding at the bottom.
